page_title: RBL 3-0 WOL | RB Leipzig v Wolfsburg 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 45858.
90+2' Referee Christian Dingert has finally had enough of Marco Rose and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+1' This is a yellow card! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Pavao Pervan guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) coming on for Amadou Haidara.
86' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Lois Openda and he is replaced by Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig).
85' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
82' 3 - 0 Dani Olmo feeds the ball through to Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:0!
78' Substitution. Mohamed Simakan makes way for Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
78' Here is a change. Ridle Baku is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
78' The game has come to an end for Kevin Behrens. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).

78' Pavao Pervan pulls off a great save to deny Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him and his close-range header went a whisker wide of the right post.
76' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) replaces Benjamin Sesko.
76' Substitution. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Xaver Schlager walks off.
75' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
74' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Peter Gulacsi comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' The total number of attempts is 9:9. 3:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
71' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
68' 2 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) neatly controls a decent pass from Xavi Simons. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 2:0.

67' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kilian Fischer leaves the pitch and Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) comes on.
65' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi reads it well and gathers the ball.
65' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.
63' The game is interrupted now, Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

63' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper pulled off a nice save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' A clumsy foul by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) and Christian Dingert blows his whistle.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.

56' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Peter Gulacsi!
55' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Amin Sarr is replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
55' The referee signals a substitution. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Moritz Jenz.
53' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
51' Half-chance! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) plays a pass into the box, but Pavao Pervan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
49' RB Leipzig string together a series of short passes.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The corner is sent into the box by Xavi Simons, but Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) flashes the ball a whisker past the right post.
45+4' Corner kick. Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is ready to send the ball into the box.
45+3' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+1' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

44' What a great chance for Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
44' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is about to take a corner kick.

43' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
42' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away.
41' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) will take the corner.
40' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.

39' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
37' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
37' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
35' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case. Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
34' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
30' Wonderful movement by Wolfsburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
29' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) brings an opponent down and Christian Dingert interrupts the game. RB Leipzig get a free kick.
27' Today's referee Christian Dingert rightly decides to book Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) for his harsh tackle.
25' The referee shows a yellow card to Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
25' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
24' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
23' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

23' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
19' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) . He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which goes a whisker over the crossbar.

13' 1 - 0 Brilliant finish! Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Xaver Schlager, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
12' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and it's Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
8' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
6' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
5' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Peter Gulacsi.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Wolfsburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Christian Dingert.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
